description: A sparse isolated field of nine tiny dim gray and taupe dust motes distributed over a transparent 64x64 canvas. Each mote is exactly one or two native pixels, with generous empty space, no central cloud or container. Motes spread across the canvas rather than forming an icon. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 64x64 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
